exam_lifecycle.submitted: HTTP 200; UI review modal showed 2/2 answered
exam_lifecycle.student_results: 10/10, Reviewed, correct answers and teacher note visible

confirmed_ui_defects.observed: Attempt summary shows Allowed 1 / Used 0 / Completed 0 / Remaining 1, and '0 exams', although the student has a Reviewed submission scoring 10/10.
confirmed_ui_defects.api_evidence: GET /api/teacher/students/{studentId} returned attemptsCount=0, attempts.used=0, attempts.completed=0, submittedAttempts=0 after the submission was graded.
confirmed_ui_defects.root_cause: Finished exams are excluded from the exam list before attempts are aggregated (Program.cs student detail endpoint filters Status != "Finished").

confirmed_ui_defects.observed: Stat card says 'جلسات يمكن فتحها 1' while the only exam is finished (status منتهي) and cannot be opened.
confirmed_ui_defects.root_cause: Counter computed as publishedExams - activeExams, without excluding finished exams.

confirmed_ui_defects.observed: Page description promises submissions in the timeline, but after a full student submission the page reports 'تسليمات 0' and the timeline has no submission.submitted event.
confirmed_ui_defects.root_cause: Audit page filters events by ActorId == teacherId; student-originated events (submission.started/submitted) are stored with the student as actor and are not visible to the teacher.

confirmed_ui_defects.observed: Page header on student review and teacher essay review falls back to the generic title 'امتحاني' instead of 'مراجعة المحاولة' / 'تصحيح المحاولة'.
confirmed_ui_defects.root_cause: teacherTitles/studentTitles maps do not contain 'review' or 'essay-review'.

confirmed_ui_defects.observed: Keyboard focus leaves an open modal after 6 Tab presses and lands on the background bottom navigation (المركز / اختبارات).
confirmed_ui_defects.root_cause: Modal implements Escape and initial focus but no focus trap and no focus restoration.
